scope: Published native Claude Code builds with default identification headers; custom header overrides and arbitrary embedded SDK applications are outside this domain
evidence_status: static artifact validation; official runtime values marked inferred in version-map.json

platform.note: Linux libc variants do not change X-Stainless-OS/Arch. Only S1/S2/S3 same-version native bytes were inspected; other pairs from S5 optionalDependencies.

constraints.rule: Keep cli_version, sdk_version, bun_version, bun_revision, runtime_version_reported and binary_sha256 from one version-map row. Unsampled versions => unknown, never interpolate as verified.
Bun matches SDK process tag; runtime header=node, runtime_version=process.version. No explicit Bun branch. Bun semver alone does not determine process.version.
For published native clients choose one published OS/Arch pair. SDK enums for iOS/Android/BSD/Other do not establish a published Claude platform.

Normal request UA entrypoint and cc_entrypoint both consume request override, then launch environment; workload comes from same async context. UA ownEntrypoint mode and pre-bootstrap defaults are explicit exceptions.
device_id persists, account_uuid belongs to active account, session_id belongs to session; x-client-request-id is per request. These scopes are different.
Evaluate ordered base/capability/request stages with auth, model facts, policy, feature flags, source and conversation latches; six scenario axes alone are insufficient.
